avis.texte: I really wanted to love this moisturizer because of its price point but I could not hate it more. It is extremely tacky and you cannot build any makeup over it, primer or no primer it just basically smudges over your face. I tried it at night and in the morning without makeup and it just feels dry and tacky on my skin. I do not have dry skin, I have more of a combination skin leaning more towards oily so for a moisturizer to feel dry on my skin is shocking.
Easy to use and very active! Every time I put this on, I am happy and so is my skin.

I was lucky enough to win this on Instagram. As a skincare addict, I was very keen to try it. I tried both products and loved them equally. The texture was perfect, just how I like it, with a very pleasant perfumed aroma. My skin felt a little tight after use, but the results in the morning were lovely, soft skin. All in all, I would definitely purchase this product in the future.
It was good. I do not have any complaints. I highly recommend it.

I really like this caviar mask. It allows for deep cleaning of my skin. Upon application, the product is a bit dry and leaves a layer on my skin. After letting it sit for 10 minutes, I rinse my skin with water. Once the product is washed off, my skin remains smooth, soft, and hydrated. The product itself does not have a particular scent and is not unpleasant to wear.
I love it! As soon as I opened it, the scent won me over. I like the texture and that it is very easy to apply; it leaves my skin feeling very hydrated.
The green caviar mask that I received is gorgeous! It leaves my skin very soft and hydrated in the morning after I have used it. I definitely recommend it!
This is a good hydrating mask in the form of a gel. After using this mask, the skin is uniform, soft, and healthy.
The green caviar mask is something special. I have never seen it before and was curious to try it. The texture and the perfume are stunning. I adore it.
I have been using this mask for only a week, but I can say that after applying this product, my skin feels soft and looks healthy.
I loved this mask; it is very nourishing and has helped improve my skin tone, and I recommend trying it.
There are no words to describe this green caviar mask because it is the absolute best. The results are clearly visible after just a few treatments.
I have not tested this yet, but it looks like it will be a good product.

After using this gel mask a couple of times per week, my skin looked and felt visibly fresher and doesn't seem as dry. As a result, I have now ordered more, and I would definitely recommend this product to anyone wanting fresh and healthy-looking skin.
It is very moisturizing and leaves my skin fresh and luminous; it has surprised me a lot.
It smells great and has a nice texture; my skin feels fabulous after using it.
It feels refreshing on the skin; it does not feel like you are wearing a face mask, so I found that a little strange at first.
This is a very good product; I am really impressed and will buy it again.
I have only tried it a few times, but its effectiveness is already clear. I like the effect it gives my skin from the very first applications.

I even like the name, green caviar. I reserve Sundays for self-care, doing a deeper skin cleansing, and that is when I apply the mask. The freshness you feel when applying it is delicious, and upon removal, the skin is noticeably soft and full of life.
The mask dries very quickly. It leaves the skin soft and smooth after use. It is a bit difficult to wash off, but I recommend it.

I have been using this mask for three days. It instantly made my skin feel hydrated, and I can already notice a difference in the brightness of my skin. I look forward to seeing the results after a few weeks. It is definitely a new staple in my skincare routine!
This is a great mask; it leaves the skin luminous and looking healthy. It has very nice packaging and is very easy to apply.
Just what my skin care routine needed: a mask that leaves your skin feeling soft and hydrated.
The products match the description and were received quickly. Apply a thin layer to the skin and rinse after 20 minutes. It has a pleasant scent.
An excellent pick-me-up for dry or dehydrated skin. It sorted my skin out after just one use; I couldn't believe it!

The Green Caviar Mask is one of skinChemists' most popular products. It is a facial mask that contains green caviar extract, hyaluronic acid, and aloe vera, among other ingredients. The Green Caviar Mask is designed to help improve skin texture and appearance by smoothing fine lines and wrinkles, leaving the skin looking more radiant and youthful.
Absolutely a must-try! It does not dry out the skin; in fact, I love it. These are my favorite skincare products.
It leaves the skin super soft and revitalized! It is truly excellent as a night mask!
The product quality is excellent, and my skin has improved significantly.
A beautiful and fragrant mask that makes the skin silky. It leaves the skin clean, hydrated, smooth, and firm. This is a product that can never be missing from a beauty routine.
Who doesn't love the sound of a caviar mask? It is very luxurious and hydrating. My skin feels refreshed and nourished after usage.
It feels amazing and leaves my skin looking super healthy. The instructions on the carton are different from those on the tube, but otherwise I have no complaints.
This is a lovely mask that I use at night. I keep it on while sleeping and then wash it off in the morning as usual. It gives my skin a nice feel and is worth a try.
I love the fact that this mask is left on overnight. It goes on smoothly, and I love the feel of my skin in the morning; there is none of that early morning dryness.

I use this mask after cleansing, as the last thing I do before I go to bed. I keep it on all night and wash it off in the morning. My skin looks hydrated and glowing. I can strongly recommend this mask.
The packaging is lovely, and it is so good for my skin. It made my skin look and feel amazing; I definitely recommend it.
I would definitely recommend this; my skin was so smooth after using it.
Excellent product. My skin looks really dewy the next morning with no dry patches.
It has a good consistency and feels nice to apply to my skin.
